architecture: Conv1D(32, kernel=3, causal) -> MaxPooling1D(2) -> LSTM(32) -> Dropout(0.20) -> Dense(32, ReLU) -> Dense(horizon)
walk_forward_method: Fixed trained model; rolling forecast origins; common 63-observation spacing so target blocks do not overlap across reported horizons.
calibration_method: Empirical absolute log-error quantiles from a separate calibration split. Calibration origins overlap; bands are descriptive and are not a formal independent-sample conformal coverage guarantee.
